extracted.intended_audience: UK-based researchers and research organisations seeking STFC/UKRI funding (particularly the UK particle physics community and invitees for metascience funding)
extracted.subtask_description: A listing/announcement page for STFC (UKRI) funding opportunities including basic eligibility and administrative details for specific calls (e.g., Particle Physics Experiment Consolidated Grants 2026 and an invite-only UKRI metascience call). Useful for prospective applicants checking eligibility, dates, and high-level fund information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Particle Physics Experiment Consolidated Grants 2026 — eligibility requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC) funding and a member of the UK particle physics community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a requirement stated on the opportunity listing; the call is for grant requests to support particle physics experiment research. Administrative dates: Publication date 1 May 2026; Opening date 11 May 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date 9 July 2026 4:00pm UK time. Funding type: Grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment — invitation-only requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply to this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunity is open to invited applicants only. Funding expectations: up to £3,000,000 total at 80% full economic cost (FEC). Co-funders and participating councils listed (UKRI, ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC) with DSIT as co-funder. Administrative dates: Publication date 28 April 2026; Opening date 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time.
